name: cabinetx
description: Inspect and edit your current Cabinet-X kitchen cabinet project through its normal workflows.

interface.longDescription: Inspect and edit your current Cabinet-X kitchen cabinet project through its normal workflows. Local desktop integration; requires Node.js 24 and the Cabinet-X project page open on the same computer. Works only with the signed-in owner’s current project. AI client subscription and usage limits apply.
capabilities: Render the current view with your AI client
defaultPrompt: Summarize my current kitchen project without making changes.
Check my cabinet design and explain the warnings.
Generate a magazine-quality render of my current view, preserve the layout, and save it as the hero image.
